title: Monoidal category
html:
Monoidal category. A category \mathbf{C} equipped with a bifunctor \otimes \colon \mathbf{C} \times \mathbf{C} \to \mathbf{C}, a distinguished unit object \mathbf{1}, and coherent natural isomorphisms for associativity (\alpha), left unitality (\lambda), and right unitality (\rho). These satisfy Mac Lane's pentagon and triangle axioms.
